Root publication/validation window 6423996634 is now closed. Root and the authority/cost agents pause commands and file mutations. **Only `/root/source_recovery` may run the independent final source/evidence/publication metadata audit after this comment is posted**, expiring 2026-10-26T18:45:36.000Z. Its writes are restricted to the new `checkpoint-045-validation/independent-review/` directory, in JSON/text/script form; no Markdown edits, product execution or remote ref changes. The reviewer will disclose its earlier recovery role and exploratory metadata-summary TypeError. Root resumes only after the reviewer closes its window and pauses.
